text: I follow through on tasks I commit to for SUSC, even when no one is checking up on me.
I pay close attention to detail when preparing for events or tasks.
I sometimes leave things until the last minute.

I often forget to follow up on things I said I'd do.
A failed event or rejected idea doesn't stop me from trying again.
I get stressed out easily when things don't go as planned.
I take setbacks personally and it affects my mood for a while.
I stay calm even when there's a lot of pressure before an event.
I actively look for ways to learn and improve, even outside my comfort zone.
I enjoy tackling problems I haven't dealt with before.
I prefer sticking to familiar tasks rather than trying new approaches.
I have plenty of ideas for how things could be done better.
I'm comfortable speaking up and taking the lead in group settings.
